Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging

Class ReleaseChangeEvent

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.ReleaseChangeEvent
  • public final class ReleaseChangeEvent
extends Object
    Information about some activated or deactivated resources in a release, to control replication.

      • newResources

        @NotNull
public @NotNull Set<String> newResources()
        A collection of resources that have been activated (that is, haven't been present before in this release). This excludes resources that are in movedResources() - you can use newOrMovedResources() for that. For all resources we have that Release.appliesToPath(String).

      • newOrMovedResources

        public Set<String> newOrMovedResources()
        A collection of resources that have been activated (that is, haven't been present before in this release), including resources that newly appear because they are in movedResources(). For all resources we have that Release.appliesToPath(String).

      • updatedResources

        @NotNull
public @NotNull Set<String> updatedResources()
        A collection of resources that have been updated (they have already been present in this release). There might have been subresources of this that have been activated or deactivated: if a full update of a whole site should be done, an ReleaseChangeEvent can be sent with an update for the site root. For all resources we have that Release.appliesToPath(String).

      • removedResources

        @NotNull
public @NotNull Set<String> removedResources()
        A collection of resources that have been deactivated (that is, have been removed from this release). This excludes resources that are in movedResources() - you can use newOrMovedResources() for that. For all resources we have that Release.appliesToPath(String).

      • removedOrMovedResources

        public Set<String> removedOrMovedResources()
        A collection of resources that have been activated (that is, haven't been present before in this release), including resources that disappear at one place because they are in movedResources(). For all resources we have that Release.appliesToPath(String).

      • addMoveOrUpdate

        public void addMoveOrUpdate​(@Nullable
                            @Nullable String rawFrompath,
                            @Nullable
                            @Nullable String rawTopath)
        Takes appropriate notice when a resource is updated and during this moved from frompath to topath - these may be the same or null if it vanishes / appears. {frompath} and {topath} may be absolute paths into the release, relative paths within the release or absolute paths into the release workspace.

      • addPath

                       String path)
        Adds a path but minimizes the set in that if some path is in there, no subpath of it is there, too, since that's subsumed.
